<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern: a strong M+1 peak (~16 % of the base peak) indicates the presence of many carbon atoms, and an M+2 peak (~4–5 % of the base peak) matches the natural abundance of 34S, indicating sulfur. No M+2 peak of ~33 % (chlorine) or ~100 % (bromine) is present, so those elements cannot be definitively identified. Thus the elements that can be definitively identified are carbon and sulfur.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'S']</final_answer>
